Navya’s feet are together on the same paving line as her friends; she looks sideways towards them with a small determined smile. Ahana looks back at her, smiling; Vihaan holds his ticket near his chest and looks relieved. Each child holds one silver invitation. The crowd behind consists only of modern urban children. printable.text: Before Tez takes the volunteers inside, he explains what ChandRush is. It is a travelling full-moon mela. On selected full-moon nights, it appears in one city behind a forgotten gate. It must welcome its visitors, pack itself and leave before moonset.

printable.text: ChandRush works through a simple rule called the Balance Rule. Its lanterns, food, costumes, games, buildings and travelling parts depend on correct numbers, patterns, shapes, measurements and chance.
